posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
If you're curious, in the video game, every player has a few locations where cards can be. Play area, deck, hand, trash, etc. And each card has two locations where other cards can be - "next to" and "under". That is where Twist the Ether goes - in the "next to" location of a card that's in a "play area" location.

Guise and Wager Master are going to be.. interesting for many reasons.
